# Homelab

> Documentation for a Kubernetes homelab on Talos Linux, provisioned by Pulumi on Proxmox

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://homelab.madhan.app/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Homelab, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://homelab.madhan.app/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Homelab

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
